Presenting RANG REJWA TU RANG AISI CHUNRI HAMAR FULL VIDEO SONG from DILLAGI movie starring Dharmendra, Hema Malini, Mithu Mukerjee, Shatrughan Sinha, Devan Verma, Asrani in lead roles, released in 1978. The song is sung by Kishore Kumar, Suman Kalyanpur and music is given by Rajesh Roshan, music is available exclusively on Gaane Sune Ansune.
Song: RANG REJWA TU RANG AISI CHUNRI HAMAR
Singer: KISHORE KUMAR, SUMAN KALYANPUR
